title: The tailor who jumped off the Eiffel Tower
caption:
He promised the police he'd test it with a dummy. Then he sent the dummy home. 🪂
A parachute slows you by catching a lot of air; a suit barely bigger than a cape catches almost none, and 57 metres gives it no time.
Would you have trusted the suit?
sources: Wikipedia, Franz Reichelt (4 February 1912; jumped from the first platform of the Eiffel Tower, about 57 m; had told police he would use a dummy; hesitated about 40 seconds; the jump was filmed)
